Title: LR2 - ED-330 - DAA system operational states implementation
Text: The DAA shall implement at least the following states:- Standby: the system is powered on but not providing its intended functions. The system is ready to transition to operational state upon command or predefined conditions; - Operational: the system is fully functional and actively performing its intending tasks and providing functions according to the specified requirements; - Failure: the system has detected a fault or error that prevents it from performing its intended functions. In this state, the system should cease all active operations and enter a safe mode.
